notes.title: Twin Stones - v 0.1.1 - Patch notes
notes.content:
First of all, thank you very much to everyone for the support, downloads and reviews. We have been working these days on fixing some important bugs to improve the game experience and finish the last level of the game. 

Below we explain the fixes and improvements:

- FIXED: Fixed a bug with the continue button that caused the player to not spawn in the correct place.

- FIXED: Fixed a bug with the particles of an enemy that caused the game to crash.

- FIXED: Different dressing and visual bugs in all levels.

- ADDED: Informative splash screens at the beginning of the game.

- ADDED: Last level and final boss. Added the last part of the ruins level that ends with the battle against the final boss. This last level is accessible from the level selector if you have already completed the previous levels.
